Thanks again for the demo today — good conversation. We confirmed internally that we'd like to proceed with a short POC to validate inference latency against our batch workloads. Daniel is the engineering lead on our side and is copied — he can share the change control ticket if needed. Can you send the exact network checklist and any temporary workarounds (e.g., proxy/egress) so we can unblock the team?

Great to hear — excited to get Atlas AI running. Quick recap + next steps from our side: 

1) Network checklist: attached is the POC-ops-checklist.pdf and a short network-requirements.xlsx your infra team asked for. The checklist covers VPC peering, required outbound ports, and a minimal test dataset flow so you can upload without exposing production data.

2) Owner for technical run-through: Ben (SE) will do a 30-minute setup call to walk Daniel through the peering and the upload flow. Ben, can you share your calendar slots Wed/Thu morning PT?

3) Kickoff window: we still have availability Apr 1–3; once Daniel confirms a slot we'll reserve an onboarding hour (no charge) to ensure the agent boots and a first inference completes.

If anything in the checklist looks off for your security posture, flag it and we can propose a narrower test (e.g., using a proxy and temporary keys).

Hey Sophie / Daniel — copying the key technical bits here so your infra change can be scoped quickly: 

- Required outbound ports: 443 (API), 5222 (control plane for telemetry) — full list in network-requirements.xlsx.
- For VPC peering we provide a dedicated peering subnet; if your security policy disallows peering we can run the POC over a temporary NAT/proxy with a signed ephemeral token.
- Uploads: small test dataset (<= 500MB) works over the portal; if you want S3 ingestion we can provide a pre-signed URL.

I'm available Wed 31 Mar 10:00–12:00 PT and Thu 1 Apr 09:00–11:00 PT for a hands-on session. Rafael — if Sophie/Daniel prefer a later date, I'll reprioritize.

Cheers,
